data.name: NOVAE: Last Light
data.detailed_description:
A universe is dying. You are its last spark.

The constellations have gone dark, devoured by entropy. Dive into each dead world, collect the star fragments that still glow,
and relight the sky — before your own light fades.

Every run is a new sky

  • Fast, readable top-down action — dash through swarms, dodge projectile storms, strike back. Pure arcade feel, no
    filler.
  • Procedurally generated worlds — enemy waves, hazards and power offers change every run. Learn the patterns, not the
    map.
  • Build your power — fallen enemies drop crystals. Choose between powers and shape your build around elemental
    affinities, run after run.
  • Face the Guardians — collect enough star fragments and each world's fallen Guardian awakens. Defeat it to move deeper
    into the dark.
  • Death is not the end — choose one heritage to carry into your next run and grow stronger across attempts.
  • Fill the bestiary — discover every creature of entropy and every Guardian you encounter.

Made to be picked up instantly

  • Plays fully with keyboard or gamepad
  • Short, intense runs — one more constellation, always
  • Minimalist neon visuals and an atmospheric soundtrack
  • Interface in English and French

data.short_description: A universe is dying — and you are its last spark. Blast through procedurally generated constellations in this fast neon action roguelite. Claim powers from fallen enemies, defeat the Guardians, and carry your heritage into every new run.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Any GPU with Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon or Intel Core i5 (universal binary)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 (64-bit) or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz (x86_64)
  • Memory: 4096 MB MB RAM
  • Graphics: Any GPU with Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
